user.title: Connect to Trakt
user.description: Choose how this integration should authorise with Trakt.

menu_options.own_app: Use my own Trakt API application

players.title: Media players
players.description: Signed in as {username}. Pick the players whose playback should be scrobbled to Trakt.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Trakt
reauth_confirm.description: Your Trakt authorization expired. Continue to authorize this integration again.

own_app.title: Your Trakt application
own_app.description: Registering an API application at {app_url} requires a Trakt VIP membership. Paste the client ID and secret of an app you already own.

progress.wait_for_authorization:
Open {url} and enter the code:

**{code}**

This window continues automatically once you approve it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Trakt. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_credentials: Trakt rejected the client ID or secret.
error.code_expired: The authorization code expired before it was approved.
error.authorization_denied: The authorization request was denied on Trakt.

abort.already_configured: This Trakt account is already set up.

data.next_episode_fallback: Guess the episode when the player only reports a show name

data_description.excluded_apps: Playback is skipped when any of these matches the app name or ID. Type a value and press enter to add it.
data_description.min_duration: Anything shorter than this is treated as a clip and ignored.
data_description.heartbeat: How often an ongoing scrobble is re-sent so Trakt tracks seeks.
data_description.next_episode_fallback: The Apple TV app reports only a series name. When enabled, the next unwatched episode from your Trakt progress is scrobbled instead of skipping it.
data_description.thumbnail_match: The Apple TV app reports only a show name. When on, the exact episode is identified by matching the player's artwork to Trakt's episode stills, instead of guessing.

parse_preview.name: Preview match
parse_preview.description: Show how a title would be parsed and which Trakt item it matches, without scrobbling anything.

player.name: Media player
player.description: Read the title and attributes from this player's current state.

title.name: Title
title.description: A media title to test instead of, or on top of, the player's own.

media_content_type.name: Content type
media_content_type.description: Override the content type used for the test.

media_duration.name: Duration
media_duration.description: Runtime in seconds, used to pick between same-named films and shows.

resolve.name: Look up on Trakt
resolve.description: Also query Trakt for the match. Turn off to test parsing only.

stop_scrobble.name: Stop scrobble
stop_scrobble.description: End the scrobble in progress for a player, submitting its current progress to Trakt.

player.name: Media player
player.description: The player whose scrobble should be stopped.

refresh_token.name: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Force a refresh of the Trakt OAuth access token.
